description.value: Simply Pho is a family-owned Vietnamese restaurant in Tsawwassen offering an extensive menu of authentic pho varieties alongside classic appetizers like spring rolls, salad rolls, and calamari. The restaurant is located in the Canoe Pass Way retail complex near the Tsawwassen Mills area, making it a convenient sit-down meal stop for cyclists riding the South Delta region. It is one of the few Vietnamese dining options in this part of the Lower Mainland.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 24m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content fully corroborates OSM contact details (address, phone) and confirms the business is an active, family-owned Vietnamese restaurant. OSM diet tags (vegan=yes, vegetarian=yes) are partially supported by a vegetable pho menu item, though it is listed as served in beef broth, making full vegan/vegetarian confirmation uncertain. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in the OSM tags or website content.
